2608.14472.title: LP-NAS: Linear Programming-based Neural Architecture Search
2608.14472.paper_summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) aims to automate neural network architecture design, reducing reliance on human expertise. Among the various NAS methods, differentiable NAS has gained prominence due to its efficiency and accuracy compared to conventional NAS approaches. Since differentiable NAS relaxes the architecture search space into a continuous domain, it is possible to apply principles from continuous optimization to NAS. In this paper, we propose Linear Programming-based NAS (LP-NAS), a mathematical programming-based framework for differentiable NAS that is applicable to a wide range of continuous search spaces. LP-NAS formulates a linear program (LP) using the validation-loss gradient and the training-loss Hessian to compute an architecture update direction that improves generalization while preserving the optimality of the model parameters. By following this LP-derived descent direction, LP-NAS efficiently navigates the architecture search space, leading to faster and more effective architecture optimization. We introduce two computationally efficient variants of LP-NAS, namely S-LP-NAS and R-LP-NAS. Applying LP-NAS to the Differentiable Architecture Search (DARTS) search space results in two algorithmic variants, S-LP-DARTS and R-LP-DARTS. Both variants achieve faster convergence and significantly higher validation performance during the early search iterations than the standard DARTS algorithm. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 show that LP-DARTS outperforms standard DARTS in both the architecture search and evaluation phases. Additionally, we compare our approach with several DARTS variants (P-DARTS, PC-DARTS, and STO-DARTS) on the CIFAR-10 dataset and demonstrate its effectiveness. Furthermore, we validate the transferability of the discovered architectures through experiments on the ImageNet dataset.
2608.14472.paper_summary_zh: 神經架構搜索（NAS）旨在自動化神經網絡架構設計，減少對人類專業知識的依賴。<lb/>在各種NAS方法中，可微分NAS因其相較於傳統NAS方法的效率和準確性而受到重視。<lb/>由於可微分NAS將架構搜索空間放鬆為連續領域，因此可以將連續優化的原則應用於NAS。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出基於線性規劃的NAS（LP-NAS），這是一個基於數學編程的可微分NAS框架，適用於廣泛的連續搜索空間。<lb/>LP-NAS使用驗證損失梯度和訓練損失Hessian來制定線性規劃（LP），以計算一個架構更新方向，該方向在保留模型參數最優性的同時改善泛化能力。<lb/>通過遵循這一基於LP的下降方向，LP-NAS有效地導航架構搜索空間，從而實現更快速和更有效的架構優化。<lb/>我們介紹了兩個計算效率高的LP-NAS變體，即S-LP-NAS和R-LP-NAS。<lb/>將LP-NAS應用於可微分架構搜索（DARTS）搜索空間，產生了兩個算法變體，S-LP-DARTS和R-LP-DARTS。<lb/>這兩個變體在早期搜索迭代中實現了比標準DARTS算法更快的收斂和顯著更高的驗證性能。<lb/>在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的大量實驗顯示，LP-DARTS在架構搜索和評估階段均優於標準DARTS。<lb/>此外，我們還在CIFAR-10數據集上將我們的方法與幾個DARTS變體（P-DARTS、PC-DARTS和STO-DARTS）進行比較，並證明了其有效性。<lb/>此外，我們通過在ImageNet數據集上的實驗驗證了所發現架構的可轉移性。
